title: Hyderabad sweet and confectionery units special enforcement drive
authority: TG SAFE (Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana)
summary: TG SAFE enforcement teams inspected sweet, confectionery and food manufacturing and retail establishments across Hyderabad on suspicion of adulteration ahead of the festive season. Over 1,035 kg of suspected adulterated food articles worth ₹7,75,850 were seized and 21 samples collected for lab testing. Three establishments had their FSSAI licences suspended with operations ordered to stop, seven show-cause notices were issued, and one unlicensed establishment was issued a closure order.

title: Hyderabad restaurants and canteens special enforcement drive
authority: TG SAFE (Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana)
summary: Seven TG SAFE enforcement teams comprising Food Safety Officers and Police inspected 13 restaurants and canteens across Hyderabad and lifted 16 food samples. Four FSSAI licences were suspended and show-cause notices were proposed for seven establishments. The official release listed two other venues among those inspected without naming a suspension or proposed notice for them.

summary: 12 TG SAFE enforcement teams comprising Food Safety Officers and Police inspected 12 Pheni and Khara manufacturing and retail establishments across the Core Urban Region (CURE). Teams seized 1,950 kg of Pheni valued at ₹2.30 lakh for labelling and quality violations, and lifted 12 samples for adulteration testing. Violations included unhygienic premises, pest infestation, pan masala spitting stains, food stored on floors, and missing health records. Five licences were suspended with immediate stop-business instructions, one unlicensed unit was ordered closed, and six show-cause notices were issued.
